blurb:
Enjoy an LED Clear Kayak Tour suitable for the whole family!

Our LED Glow tour is a truly unique way to enjoy an evening on Lake Tahoe! The LED Glow tour begins at dusk and takes guests on a short eco paddle as the sky begins to darken, and the glow from the LED lights begin to take over. Guests will have the opportunity to experience some surrounding plants and animals and enjoy the relaxing evening paddle with a bioluminescent ambiance.
